pm_open_level1_1.text: Morning. Three thousand feet, three crews. Dig Day 1, pipe Day 2, backfill Day 4. We promised the city Day 18, so keep everybody moving.

pm_hold_level1_1.text: You're holding a crew? We promised Day 18. I hope you have a reason.

pm_end_level1_1.text: That's the run. Look at where the lines ended up against what we promised.

marcus_collapse_1.text: Wall's moving! Out of the hole, everybody out, now!

marcus_collapse_2.text: Okay. Everybody's out, nobody's hurt. That whole side let go at five-twenty, and there's water coming in at the bottom.

marcus_collapse_3.text: I'm not putting a man back down there until somebody cleans that up.

arg_back_pipe_stopped_1.text: Marcus, why is your crew standing on the bank? I've got a loader full of dirt and nowhere to put it.

arg_back_pipe_stopped_2.text: Because my wall's in the ditch, Dana. Push dirt onto my bedding and you can explain it to the inspector.

arg_back_pipe_stopped_3.text: The schedule had me here today. I lay two-fifty a day. You lay one-eighty on a good day.

arg_back_pipe_stopped_4.text: Then the schedule was wrong before the wall ever moved. Somebody tell the office.

arg_back_pipe_caught_1.text: Marcus, I'm on your heels again. Pick it up or get out of my way.

arg_back_pipe_caught_2.text: I lay one-eighty a day, Dana, same as every day. You lay two-fifty. Do the math.

arg_back_pipe_caught_3.text: The math says I sit here and get paid to watch you.

arg_back_pipe_caught_4.text: Take it up with whoever wrote the start dates.

grumble_back_pipe_2.text: I heard you the first time.

ray_working_1.text: Morning, inspector. Good ground today. We'll make our footage if nobody bothers us.

marcus_idle_1.text: Nothing to lay until that wall's cleaned up. My guys are standing around.

dana_working_1.text: Dirt's going in fine. Just keep me fed.

marcus_working_1.text: Pipe's going in. One-eighty a day if the walls behave.

dana_idle_1.text: We're right on Marcus's heels. Nothing to fill until he lays more pipe.

foreman_held_02_1.text: Second day on a hold. My guys are getting paid to watch a trench.

foreman_held_03_1.text: Three days. Either give me a stretch to fill or send us home.
